name: logfit
description: N분할 순환 루틴 기반 PWA 운동 일지 모바일 앱

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:test: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradlew.js -p android testDebugUnitTest lintDebug
scripts.android:test:device: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradlew.js -p android :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm audit --audit-level=moderate && npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradlew.js -p android clean testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug bundleRelease
scripts.release:bundle:signed: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradlew.js -p android verifyReleaseSigningConfig bundleRelease
